// Adds a camera's Exif block, in one of the layouts ExifTool documents for
// camera videos, to a movie or an AVI made by ffmpeg. The Exif values are
// made up: Make, Model, a lens, the date taken and a GPS position.
//
// Usage: go run camexif.go <layout> <in> <out> <make> <model> <lens> <date> <lat> <lon>
//
// Layouts: QVMI, MVTG, RMKN, SIGM (a box in moov's udta; moov must be the
// last top-level box, so no chunk offset moves); strd (an AVI strd chunk
// starting "AVIF", taking the start of the first stream's JUNK chunk);
// junk (an AVI top-level JUNK chunk starting "QVMI", written over the
// start of ffmpeg's).
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

// byteOrder writes values in a byte order.
type byteOrder interface {
	binary.ByteOrder
	binary.AppendByteOrder
}

type entry struct {
	tag, typ uint16
	count    uint32
	value    []byte // the value's bytes; a pointer for an IFD
	ifd      *ifd
}

type ifd struct{ entries []entry }

func ascii(tag uint16, s string) entry {
	return entry{tag: tag, typ: 2, count: uint32(len(s) + 1), value: append([]byte(s), 0)}
}

// block writes IFD0 at ifdAt in a buffer starting with prefix (ifdAt
// bytes), offsets counting from base.
func block(o byteOrder, prefix []byte, base int, root *ifd) []byte {
	buf := append([]byte(nil), prefix...)
	// Lay out the IFDs one after another, then their values.
	var order []*ifd
	var walk func(d *ifd)
	walk = func(d *ifd) {
		order = append(order, d)
		for _, e := range d.entries {
			if e.ifd != nil {
				walk(e.ifd)
			}
		}
	}
	walk(root)
	at := map[*ifd]int{}
	pos := len(buf)
	for _, d := range order {
		at[d] = pos
		pos += 2 + 12*len(d.entries) + 4
	}
	data := pos
	var values []byte
	for _, d := range order {
		b := o.AppendUint16(nil, uint16(len(d.entries)))
		for _, e := range d.entries {
			b = o.AppendUint16(b, e.tag)
			b = o.AppendUint16(b, e.typ)
			if e.ifd != nil {
				b = o.AppendUint32(b, 1)
				b = o.AppendUint32(b, uint32(at[e.ifd]-base))
				continue
			}
			b = o.AppendUint32(b, e.count)
			if len(e.value) <= 4 {
				v := make([]byte, 4)
				copy(v, e.value)
				b = append(b, v...)
				continue
			}
			b = o.AppendUint32(b, uint32(data+len(values)-base))
			values = append(values, e.value...)
			if len(values)%2 == 1 {
				values = append(values, 0)
			}
		}
		buf = append(buf, o.AppendUint32(b, 0)...)
	}
	return append(buf, values...)
}

func rational3(o byteOrder, v float64) []byte {
	v = math.Abs(v)
	d := math.Floor(v)
	m := math.Floor((v - d) * 60)
	s := ((v-d)*60 - m) * 60
	var b []byte
	for _, p := range [][2]uint32{{uint32(d), 1}, {uint32(m), 1}, {uint32(math.Round(s * 100)), 100}} {
		b = o.AppendUint32(o.AppendUint32(b, p[0]), p[1])
	}
	return b
}

func exif(o byteOrder, make_, model, lens, date string, lat, lon float64) *ifd {
	latRef, lonRef := "N", "E"
	if lat < 0 {
		latRef = "S"
	}
	if lon < 0 {
		lonRef = "W"
	}
	gps := &ifd{entries: []entry{
		{tag: 0, typ: 1, count: 4, value: []byte{2, 3, 0, 0}},
		ascii(1, latRef),
		{tag: 2, typ: 5, count: 3, value: rational3(o, lat)},
		ascii(3, lonRef),
		{tag: 4, typ: 5, count: 3, value: rational3(o, lon)},
	}}
	exifIFD := &ifd{entries: []entry{ascii(0x9003, date), ascii(0x9004, date)}}
	if lens != "" {
		exifIFD.entries = append(exifIFD.entries, ascii(0xA434, lens))
	}
	return &ifd{entries: []entry{
		ascii(0x010F, make_),
		ascii(0x0110, model),
		{tag: 0x8769, typ: 4, ifd: exifIFD},
		{tag: 0x8825, typ: 4, ifd: gps},
	}}
}

func box(typ string, body []byte) []byte {
	return append(binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(8+len(body))), append([]byte(typ), body...)...)
}

func chunk(id string, data []byte) []byte {
	if len(data)%2 == 1 {
		data = append(data, 0)
	}
	return append(binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32([]byte(id), uint32(len(data))), data...)
}

// addToUdta puts b at the end of moov's udta (a new udta at moov's end
// where it has none); moov must be the file's last box.
func addToUdta(in, b []byte) []byte {
	at := 0
	for at+8 <= len(in) && string(in[at+4:at+8]) != "moov" {
		at += int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(in[at:]))
	}
	moovEnd := at + int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(in[at:]))
	if moovEnd != len(in) {
		panic("moov isn't last")
	}
	out := append([]byte(nil), in...)
	for k := at + 8; k+8 <= moovEnd; k += int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(out[k:])) {
		if string(out[k+4:k+8]) == "udta" {
			end := k + int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(out[k:]))
			out = append(append(append([]byte(nil), out[:end]...), b...), out[end:]...)
			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[k:], binary.BigEndian.Uint32(out[k:])+uint32(len(b)))
			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[at:], binary.BigEndian.Uint32(out[at:])+uint32(len(b)))
			return out
		}
	}
	u := box("udta", b)
	out = append(out, u...)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[at:], binary.BigEndian.Uint32(out[at:])+uint32(len(u)))
	return out
}

// riff finds the first chunk id (a list's own type for a LIST) in
// [start, end): where its header starts and its data's length.
func riff(b []byte, start, end int, id string) (int, int) {
	for at := start; at+8 <= end; {
		n := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(b[at+4:]))
		got := string(b[at : at+4])
		if got == "LIST" {
			got = string(b[at+8 : at+12])
		}
		if got == id {
			return at, n
		}
		at += 8 + n + n&1
	}
	panic("no " + id)
}

func main() {
	a := os.Args[1:]
	layout, in, out := a[0], a[1], a[2]
	lat, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(a[7], 64)
	lon, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(a[8], 64)
	src, err := os.ReadFile(in)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	le, be := binary.LittleEndian, binary.BigEndian
	x := func(o byteOrder) *ifd { return exif(o, a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], lat, lon) }
	tiff := func(o byteOrder) []byte {
		h := []byte("II*\x00\x08\x00\x00\x00")
		if o == be {
			h = []byte("MM\x00*\x00\x00\x00\x08")
		}
		return block(o, h, 0, x(o))
	}
	qvmi := []byte("QVMI\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00")
	var res []byte
	switch layout {
	case "QVMI":
		res = addToUdta(src, box("QVMI", block(be, qvmi, 0, x(be))))
	case "MVTG":
		res = addToUdta(src, box("MVTG", block(le, make([]byte, 16), 16, x(le))))
	case "RMKN":
		res = addToUdta(src, box("RMKN", tiff(le)))
	case "SIGM":
		res = addToUdta(src, box("SIGM", tiff(be)))
	case "strd":
		// The first stream's JUNK: a strd chunk, then the JUNK left.
		hdrl, hn := riff(src, 12, len(src), "hdrl")
		strl, sn := riff(src, hdrl+12, hdrl+8+hn, "strl")
		junk, jn := riff(src, strl+12, strl+8+sn, "JUNK")
		strd := chunk("strd", block(le, []byte("AVIF\x00\x00\x00\x00"), 8, x(le)))
		rest := jn - len(strd)
		if rest < 0 || rest%2 == 1 {
			panic("the strd chunk doesn't fit the JUNK chunk")
		}
		res = append(append(append(append([]byte(nil), src[:junk]...), strd...), chunk("JUNK", make([]byte, rest))...), src[junk+8+jn:]...)
	case "junk":
		// ffmpeg's top-level JUNK, its data now Casio's block.
		junk, jn := riff(src, 12, len(src), "JUNK")
		b := block(be, qvmi, 0, x(be))
		if len(b) > jn {
			panic("the block doesn't fit the JUNK chunk")
		}
		res = append([]byte(nil), src...)
		copy(res[junk+8:], b)
	default:
		panic("layout " + layout)
	}
	if layout == "strd" || layout == "junk" {
		if !bytes.Equal(res[:4], []byte("RIFF")) || len(res) != len(src) {
			panic("the AVI changed size")
		}
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, res, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, layout, len(src), "->", len(res))
}
